about: BN4 Red Sun's GutsSoul taken with an Atk+ chip merged in the same Custom screen: his pass adds 30 to PanlSht1 on top of Attck+10's 10, 40 in all, in both games (BN4's form state zeroes the hand's six bonuses before the form's routine, 0x0800E068, but the merge lands after it), in BN4's own battle fought twice, each in a process of its own: its control. A deck of PanlSht1 A, Attck+10 * and PanlSht1 A (BN4's 178, 149, 178; BN6's 559, Atk+10 192, 559): the first Custom screen picks all three, the last PanlSht1 lighting UNITE, which takes it and the Soul. A at fight frame 30 uses the first PanlSht1 with its 40. A MettaurSP at (4,2), MegaMan at (3,2) with 2000 HP, kept from harm.
